author_attribution: Yingying Fan (2025), DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.28682348.v1; inherited CC BY 4.0 record
derivation: Existing ascending author CSV, restricted to the previously authorized first 950 rows. Original quoted prices unchanged.
identity_limits: Not a new certification of original depositor ownership, exchange closing-price semantics, exact trading calendar, historical publication or vintage availability.
date_usage: Chronological order and year splits only
2022: Exposed in older project stages; not read or scored here
issued_forecast_origins: 459..929 inclusive, 471 total; score mask retains 451 same-year complete targets
Ridge_tree_forecast_columns: Only columns h=1,5,20 are fitted and evaluated. Other columns contain zero STORAGE PLACEHOLDERS, not fitted forecasts, and MUST NOT be scored as other-horizon results.
mean_seed_loss: Average squared losses over four independently initialized models, then equal year/horizon ratios
forecast_ensemble: Average predictions first, then evaluate; reported separately
working_posterior: Conditional on a fitted selected Gaussian reference; excludes model-selection and parameter uncertainty; not calibrated economic truth
license_scope: No third-party paper full text or restricted vendor code included. Source URLs and partial reading levels are recorded separately.
